quotes.text: 501. LA SEMANA PASADA, DEL……...........… AL……..…., ¿TUVO UD. ALGÚN TRABAJO? (Sin contar los quehaceres del hogar)
546. ¿QUÉ ESTUVO HACIENDO LA SEMANA PASADA: ... Quehaceres del hogar? ............................. 5
549. ¿POR QUÉ NO BUSCÓ TRABAJO? ... Los quehaceres del hogar no le permiten ............................................. 6
Sólo realizó quehaceres del hogar? ............................ 8 Pase a pgta. 212
quotes.location: 200. CARACTERÍSTICAS DE LOS MIEMBROS DEL HOGAR, Q211A, p. 7

assessments.reasoning:
Responsibility: False. The instrument does not contain any questions asking who is responsible for, plans, organizes, or is in charge of unpaid domestic or care work.

Performance: False. The survey mentions 'quehaceres del hogar' in Q501 to explicitly exclude domestic tasks from paid work, in Q546 as an activity status option for inactive persons, in Q549 as a reason for not seeking work, and in Q211A as an activity classification option for children. Per the criteria, options classifying activity status or reasons for not working/seeking work do not count as asking whether a person performs domestic or care tasks.

Magnitude: False. Hours worked are measured for economic activities (e.g. Q513, Q518, Q211D), but no questions measure the time or frequency devoted to unpaid domestic or care work. In Q211A, selecting option 8 ('Sólo realizó quehaceres del hogar') explicitly instructs to skip Q211D ('Pase a pgta. 212'), bypassing the recording of hours.
